title: 生涯スポーツ演習(100km歩行)
subtitle: Academic Exercises on Lifelong Sports
courseType:
Student and Study Skills Courses Program
Character Building Courses
Lifelong Sports
educationalGoal: By studying the skills of 100km walking, students will learn the following: 1. Knowledge and ability to practice various sports activities voluntarily and through their own initiative based on plan-do-check-action cycle. 2. Necessities for social/student life such as observation of the rules, respect and kindness for others, challenging spirit, leadership/cooperation, sense of responsibility, safety awareness, and communication skills.
advice: This class aims to achieve the above-mentioned learning objectives through the learning of 100km walking activities. 1.Overview (1)This class is Intensive lecture Walk 100km from Anamizu campus to Nonoichi campus in about 29 hours. (2)100km walking is the KIT festival event, therefor we must follow the rules of the KIT festival organizer. 2. Specifically, students will learn the following: (1)Understanding about walking - Knowledge about suitable walking posture, walking pace, walking clothes for long distance walking. (2)Understanding about safety awareness. - Observe traffic rules, because this event is conducted on regular roads. (3)Understanding about preparation for long distance walking. -100km walking is physically and mental harsh, and must be prepared for long distance walking. 3.Earn credit Earn credit requirement is to walk 100km completely.

activityGoals.body: Be able to express the importance of enjoying a sports life throughout their own lifetime.
Be able to get various fundamental skills of long distance walking, and to use them in the class activities.
Be able to evaluate and explain their own situations and improvements in sports activities based on PDCA cycle.
Be able to understand necessities for social life and to implement them in the class activities.
Be able to express problems and improvements for a healthy life by looking back own daily life.
Be able to understand safety management in sports and to implement this understand in learning.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Accurately express the importance of enjoying a sports life throughout one's own lifetime. (2) Learn fundamental skills of long distance walking, and fully use them in the class activities. (3) Accurately evaluate and explain personal/ team's situations and improvements in sports activities based on the plan-do-check-action cycle. (4) Understand necessities for social life and to fully implement them in the class activities. (5) Accurately express one's own problems and improvements for a healthy life by self-evaluating daily life habits. (6) Full understand safety management in sports activities, and appropriately implement them in learning activities.
